Class ApplicationServlet

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
com.qm.bupt.servlet.BaseServlet
com.qm.bupt.servlet.ApplicationServlet
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable
@WebServlet("/application") public class ApplicationServlet extends BaseServlet
Servlet handling job application operations: applying, auditing, listing, and cancelling.

Mapped to /application?action=xxx. TAs can apply for and cancel their own applications; MOs can review applications for their job postings.
